verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows a built-in AI assistant inside Clerk's dashboard or product that users can hand tasks to. What the evidence does show is adjacent: a remote MCP server that external agents (Claude, Cursor, Copilot) connect to, eve tool-call authorization primitives for developers, and pages about external coding agents reading Clerk docs. None of these is an in-product assistant, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
